name: Wicker Park Warlords
description: The Wicker Park Warlords were a Chicago street gang that originated in 1964 in the Wicker Park neighborhood, founded by a member named Frank who assembled a Latin Kings softball team under the Warlords name. They established their headquarters at Evergreen and Damen and later grew multiple sections including La Familia Warlords, Spaulding Warlords, Clemente Warlords, Bucktown Warlords, and Anderson Warlords. In 1969, the Warlords helped form the United Neighborhoods alliance alongside the Spanish Lords and Latin Kings to defend Puerto Rican communities against white greaser gangs. Their primary enemies were the Taylor Jousters, Chi-West, Gaylords, PVR/PVPs, and Vice Lords.
